title: Skyrimnet Prompts - Cache Enabled
description:
This set of prompts are structured to utilize cached input, thereby increasing speed and reducing costs. In tests, this was able to reduce the cost of some models by more than 56% with no observable drop in quality. When using this build, you may consider significantly increasing the size of your number of events in the history, as this is far cheaper with this set of prompts.

This may not be suitable for all models, and may cause regressions on some small local models. This is the recommended set of models for Fateless.ai users, and will be the default set of models in a future release as well.
author: min
changelog: Improved the relevancy of player thought and player transform dialogues. Fixed an issue resulting in warnings if SeverActions is not installed.
